from pathlib import Path
import json,shutil,subprocess
task=Path('.local/tool-tasks/stand-pat-owned-turn-20261007').resolve()
build=task/'build-native-c'
shutil.copyfile('CombatSolver.json',build/'CombatSolver.json')
for suffix,scenario in [('prune-c','STAND-PAT-OWNED'),('regen-c','STAND-PAT-OWNED-REGEN')]:
 cmd=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id',scenario,'--character-id','IRONCLAD','--encounter-id','NIBBITS_WEAK','--seed','MANDATORY-END-TURN-20261007','--combat-solver-build-dir',str(build),'--headless-instance','stand-pat-owned-'+suffix+'-20261007','--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(task/('native-'+suffix)),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 (task/('native-'+suffix+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd},indent=2)+'\n')
 with (task/('native-'+suffix+'.log')).open('w') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 p=task/('native-'+suffix)/'result.json'
 print('launcher',suffix,r.returncode,flush=True)
 if p.exists():
  data=json.loads(p.read_text())
  print(json.dumps({k:data.get(k) for k in ['runId','status','elapsedMilliseconds','completedChecks','error']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
 if r.returncode:raise SystemExit(r.returncode)

def counters(record):
    result = {}
    for message in record.get('mandatoryDiagnostics', []):
        for key, value in re.findall(r'(\w+)=(\d+)', message):
            result[key] = result.get(key, 0) + int(value)
    return result
def summarize(records):
    result = []
    for scene in dict.fromkeys(r['scene'] for r in records):
        runs = [r for r in records if r['scene'] == scene]
        assert all(r['status'] == 'Completed' and r['exitCode'] == 0 for r in runs)
        assert all(not r['timeBoundaryObserved'] for r in runs)
        for field in ['rootStampSha256', 'policy', 'budget']:
            assert all(r[field] == runs[0][field] for r in runs), (scene, field)
        controls = [r for r in runs if r['label'].startswith('A')]
        candidates = [r for r in runs if r['label'].startswith('C')]
        before = statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in controls)
        after = statistics.mean(r['wallSeconds'] for r in candidates)
        peak_before = statistics.mean(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in controls)
        peak_after = statistics.mean(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in candidates)
        quality_diffs = []
        for r in runs:
            diffs = {k: {'control': v, 'actual': r['comparisonQuality'][k]}
                     for k, v in runs[0]['comparisonQuality'].items()
                     if r['comparisonQuality'][k] != v}
            if diffs:
                quality_diffs.append({'label': r['label'], 'differences': diffs})
        result.append({'scene': scene, 'controlSeconds': before, 'candidateSeconds': after,
                       'speedup': before / after, 'peakRssChangePercent': (peak_after / peak_before - 1) * 100,
                       'memoryGatePassed': peak_after <= peak_before * 1.1,
                       'hpLossNeverIncreased': all(r['comparisonQuality']['projectedBattleHpLost'] <=
                                                  runs[0]['comparisonQuality']['projectedBattleHpLost'] for r in candidates),
                       'qualityDifferences': quality_diffs,
                       'qualityControl': runs[0]['comparisonQuality'],
                       'countersByRun': {r['label']: counters(r) for r in candidates}})
    return result
